data.name: Hermenegild
data.gender_notes: Hermenegild is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin words heros (soldier) and merced (mercy). The name Hermenegild was given to a Christian Visigothic prince who was known for his piety and courage. He refused to renounce his faith during the Arian heresy and was executed for his belief. The name Hermenegild carries the meaning “Soldier of Mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hermenegild usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier of mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing faith and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Hermenegild belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soldier of Mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hermenegild total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
